The Simi (aka IZIP E3 Simi) is a 2019 model and appears no longer sold, but the maker doesn't say 'discontinued', so status is left empty. Both sources are 2019 reviews (Electric Bike Report part 1; ElectricBikeReview 'MODEL YEAR: ⟶ 2019'). They differ slightly on weight (54.1 vs 52.3 lb) and Wh (418 vs 417.6). EBR's drivetrain line ('7Speed 1x11 Shimano RD-RX817 GRX Di2') looks like a copy error. Price is the 2019 MSRP.
